vsam.why: base/cntl/adef121.jcl DEFINE1: DATA(... KEYS(10 0) RECORDSIZE(225 225)); the engine's facts do not read KEYS / RECORDSIZE inside the DATA component, so the case states them

notes: GenApp's VSAM 'customer key range' inquiry (LGICVS01, transaction LGCF in the CSD, a terminal transaction: no program LINKs it). It reads TS queue GENACNTL (ITEM(1), then NEXT until ITEMERR) for the 'LOW CUSTOMER=' / 'HIGH CUSTOMER=' items GenApp's LGSETUP writes, takes a key = INTEGER(RANDOM(EIBTASKN) * (HIGH - LOW) + LOW), and EXEC CICS READ FILE('KSDSCUST') INTO(CA-AREA) LENGTH(F82 = 225) RIDFLD(WRITE-MSG-HIGH) KEYLENGTH(F10 = 10) GTEQ (#4270, oracle_assumptions.md X22): the key itself when on file, else the first greater key; NOTFND past the last. On NORMAL the record's number replaces the key; SEND TEXT FROM(WRITE-MSG-H) LENGTH(24) then shows 'HIGH CUSTOMER=' and the 10 bytes after it in WRITE-MSG (a LENGTH past FROM, inside its record). Facts stated on both sides: STARTCODE 'TD' (a terminal task, X19), the terminal's input 'LGCF' (an unformatted RECEIVE), the queue GENACNTL as LGSETUP leaves it, EIBTASKN (X21), the region (ASSIGN SYSID, unused after). Not exercised: an empty GENACNTL -- the program then WRITEQs 'LOW CUSTOMER=' FROM(WRITE-MSG-L) X(13) LENGTH(23), past its FROM item (X6, refused); and the COMMAREA path (a START with data, or LINKed), which no GenApp program takes. Data: ksdscust.txt holds the ten GenApp sample customers of genapp-lgucvs01 plus two SYNTHETIC ones (0001000005, 0001000009: details copied from customer 1) so a key between them and past the last exists. region.why: a deployment fact: LGICVS01 ASSIGNs SYSID (unused afterwards); GenApp names no region in the corpus

scenarios.name: gteq-key-on-file
scenarios.why: LOW = HIGH = 3: the key is 0000000003, on file; READ GTEQ reads it (NORMAL) and SEND TEXT shows HIGH CUSTOMER=0000000003

scenarios.name: gteq-next-key
scenarios.why: the key 0000000011 is not on file: GTEQ reads the first greater key, 0001000005 (NORMAL), and its number is sent

scenarios.name: gteq-past-the-end
scenarios.why: no key >= 0002000000: NOTFND (RESP2 80); WRITE-MSG-HIGH keeps the key asked for

scenarios.name: gteq-random-in-range
scenarios.why: LOW 1, HIGH 10: the key is FUNCTION RANDOM(EIBTASKN) scaled into the range (C12, X21), read by GTEQ
